basic_info.description: Originally designed in 1913 by master architect G. Albert Lansburgh, this beautiful Presidio Heights home blends classic Beaux-Arts styling with a contemporary perspective. Architectural richness abounds inside & out, w/the facade's arched windows & ornamental moldings creating an elegant first impression. The 3-level floor plan of 5BD/4.5BA benefits from a wide lot & an xlnt expansion & renovation. The integrity of the original design has been preserved, while greatly enhancing living space & modern function. Premium custom touches cascade throughout the home from the wainscoted walls & polished nickel hardware to the decorative ceiling treatments & sophisticated lighting. Whether it's relaxed family living or formal entertaining, this home accommodates every occasion. The graceful LR & DR transition to the gourmet chef's kitchen which opens to the breakfast area & family room. The upper level boasts a sought-after floor plan of 4BD/3BA, including the sensational primary suite w/wood burning frplc & views of the Golden Gate & Marin Headlands. Romantic terraces overlook the stylish rear garden designed by Andrea Cochran Landscape Architecture. A guest suite is found on the lower level along w/2 large rooms which offer versatility for a playroom, game room, home theater or office.
